newsitem.title: PARAGUAY: Paraguay industry output slips in Jan-Aug period.
newsitem.headline: Paraguay industry output slips in Jan-Aug period.

text.p: Paraguay's main industries reported lower production in the January-August period than in the same period 1995, according to Central Bank figures.

Monthly commulative figures showed a 0.36 percent fall in beverage production, a 14 percent drop in wheat byproducts and 22 percent decline in tobacco, all compared with the first eight months of 1995.
On the other hand, the bank reported a 0.3 percent rise in beef production over the same period.
The Central Bank does not release a general index for industrial activity.
